pending_diagnosis: DIAGNOSIS: Anti-NMDA Receptor Encephalitis ( secondary to Ovarian Teratoma ) THE SMOKING GUN: The pathognomonic EEG extreme delta brush pattern paired with continuous orofacial dyskinesias and a mature ovarian teratoma. PATHOPHYSIOLOGY: This autoimmune encephalitis is driven by pathogenic IgG antibodies targeted against the GluN1 subunit of the NMDA receptor. Ectopic neural tissue residing within an ovarian teratoma triggers an immune reaction that breaks self-tolerance. The resulting autoantibodies cross the blood-brain barrier and cause cross-linking and internalization of surface NMDA receptors, leading to reversible synaptic dysfunction, severe psychiatric disturbance, dyskinesias, autonomic breakdown, and respiratory depression.
